question: What source and recorded processing evidence is available for the 134 archived detector-vintage Abu Dhabi seam components?

identity_rule.stable_id: SHA256(original administrative member feature ID + ':' + str(source ECO_ID))[:20], prefixed atlas:physical:
identity_rule.resolution: Atlas IDs resolve to ECO_ID 810 and 811. Current service ObjectID values 38 and 825 are separate row identifiers. The deliberately wrong ObjectID 810/811 selection returns ECO_ID 519 and 643; it is only a negative identity control.

observed_operations: make_valid on source shapes and output intersections/differences
simplify(.001, preserve_topology=True) on source features in longitude/latitude coordinates
skip empty or estimated area <5 km2 source intersections; require at least two >=500 km2 pieces for subdivision unless anonymous
for residuals, attempt buffers at .001,.005,.01,.025,.05,.1 degrees and record adjustments
retain source district on significant uncovered area or insufficient source coverage rather than assign a distant polygon
recorded_processing_code.interpretation_limit: These are generator rules and plausible processing mechanisms. Shared district adjustment metadata, current source geometry matches, and exact component contacts do not prove which operation caused any selected residual.

historical_source_bytes.hash: not recorded in immutable Git inputs inspected
historical_source_bytes.limit: Current 2026 hosted response matches ECO_ID/name identity but cannot authenticate the historical .cache source bytes or effective date.

administrative_source.vintage_limit: Registry says boundary year 2017; effective survey date is not independently verified.

final_assessment: Per-component causal classification is unknown for all 134; see overlay-v1.json. Current source footprints intersect, but historical source equivalence and processing causality are not established; no independent water/ice evidence was found.
